title: Pharmacokinetics/pharmacodynamics of systemically administered polymyxin B against Klebsiella pneumoniae in mouse thigh and lung infection models
locator: Methods / Pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic analyses; Results, Figures 1-3 and Table 1 footnote
summary: Joint analysis of five SC dose groups evaluated compartment and nonlinear processes. The selected model had parallel absorption and elimination pathways; SC bioavailability was assumed. Plotted means do not constitute individual longitudinal records.
validation: Animal model diagnostics support that dataset; neither the model nor fitted parameters can be transferred automatically.
data_availability: Published curves and supplementary document listed; individual estimation dataset not verified.
